name: linro
description: Linro — Cloudflare-native private link management with a bilingual GUI, D1 and Access.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:worker && npm run build:web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run preflight && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/admin/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run preflight && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:runtime && npm run deploy:admin && npm run deploy:redirect
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run preflight && wrangler deploy --config apps/admin/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:redirect: npm run preflight && wrangler deploy --config apps/redirect/wrangler.jsonc && npm run verify:deployment
scripts.deploy:dry-run: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/admin/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/redirect/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.backup: wrangler d1 export DB --remote --config apps/admin/wrangler.jsonc --output Linro-backup.sql
scripts.test:runtime: npm run toolchain:versions && npm run test:runtime:canary && node --test tests/runtime/fetch-security.test.mjs tests/runtime/link-controls.test.mjs
